items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: a guy by the name of Al Brown

ctx.x: We were -- I said Buddy De Franco, and you said you'd just gone into the Strand Theater.

Yeah. This band was completely out of hand. This was during the war and some of the people we had in the band were very unstable, to put it lightly. So much so that -- well, various events like tying the hands of the clock backstage in a know, deliberately messing up the rising pit, so that it would jam on the way down, by running over to the side as it started down, and it would jam. And all sorts of minor atrocities. So much so that the management of the Strand called the union and the union sent a guy down and…
